text_block_list.text:
The fateful third year. This year, Mayano 
Top Gun takes on the Senior Class 
challenge.
—This year will surely be a decisive one.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Trainer-chan, no stiff faces 
allowed~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We're on a shrine date, you know? So give 
me a big smile☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, 'cause it's fun, that's why!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. You know, Maya went and decided on 
this year's goal♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I promise I'll... surpass that person... 
I'll surpass Brian-san at her absolute 
best!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I thought about it over and over... And 
even so, this is—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—It was the number one thing I wanted to 
do right now!
choice_data_list: You can definitely make it come true.
You can definitely make it come true.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nihihi~ Maya thinks so too♪

—Seeing her laugh like that, the thought 
crossed my mind once more.
choice_data_list:
May you stay healthy and well just like 
this.

I want them to learn a lot and grow up 
well.
May you grow into a wonderful adult.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hm? Trainer-chan. Did you say something~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? No fair, no fair! Praying all by 
yourself before everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No fair, redo! Trainer, you have to pray 
together with Maya!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And once we're done praying, we're 
continuing our date, okayー♪ Deal?☆

"And on the way back from the New Year's 
shrine visit, we had a street-food date 
together before heading home."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're making that face again~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you know...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"A face that says ‘What can I do for 
Maya?’ A face that says ‘I wanna cherish 
Maya!’"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that face of yours gives me a huge 
burst of energy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, all right! Shall we get started on 
the first training of the year? ☆

And on this day, I held our first training 
of the new year with Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Heheheh... Trainer-chan. Naïve, so naïve!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya is gonna become a wonderful, mature 
woman~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You've got it all wrong~! Jeez!! The 
difference between a "grown-up" and a 
"mature woman" is...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder what it is.
choice_data_list: Maybe you just don't get it after all...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa!? No, nooo!! There really is a 
difference, you know~!!

Later on, I spotted Mayano Top Gun having 
a staring contest with a dictionary in the 
library.
